ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters. Estimated white-to-black pixel ratio is approximately 0.15:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense white punctate mottling concentrated along the central peduncle base and lower margins. Distinct circular white ring-shaped pixel clusters distributed bilaterally. Large irregular white patch on the distal upper region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with an estimated interior angle of 90-95 degrees. Depth is approximately 15% of the total visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration along the entire trailing edge. Peaks and valleys ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in depth, with maximum irregularity located on the distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric concave trailing edge curve sweeping upward to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular rings (depigmented scars) scattered across both lobes. Dense clusters of white punctate spots along the lower medial borders.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, horizontal and diagonal white linear streaks visible on the right lobe, disrupting the dark base pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Clusters of brownish-orange epibionts (barnacles) attached to the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Significant circular scarring present throughout the ventral surface.
